text:
Asha R: Quick prototype for the structured-return flow in the playground — pushed a short gif + figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz. Focus questions: run trace UI (stacked vs inline), and how tool outputs surface. Thoughts?

Tom K: Nice start. Stacked is cleaner but if everything is collapsed users might miss inputs. Need a clear affordance for expanded outputs.

Priya S: :thumbsup: Accessibility note — collapsed sections must have aria-expanded and keyboard focus. Also status badge color contrast is borderline (especially the orange).

Asha R: Agree on contrast. Thinking of adding chevrons + `Ctrl/Cmd+K` quick-open to jump to specific tool output. Also a small copy tweak: currently we label panels "Result" — would "Tool output" be clearer?

Nate L: I prefer "Tool output". Also let's surface execution time: `42 ms` under the header. Example payload we can show: `run_time_ms: 42`.

DevBot: prototype-snapshot uploaded to staging at 1902001800

Tom K: On run history: users want to re-run from a particular step. Suggest adding a "Replay from here" action on each tool output row.

Priya S: For keyboard/screenreader: make "Replay from here" reachable via Enter when focused. SR announcement should be: "Replay from step 2: call to SearchTool" so context is explicit.

Asha R: For the schema editor: do we inline full function params or show a compact summary with an expand? Inline helps discovery but makes the editor dense. My proposal: compact summary (name + types + required badge) + chevron to expand full schema.

Tom K: Compact summary with micro-badges sounds good. Hover shows example value. On mobile we should default to single-line summary.

Priya S: Copy suggestion: instead of the header text "Schema" use "Function signature" — less jargon to non-technical users. Also ARIA snippet I'd add: `aria-expanded=\"false\"` and `aria-controls=\"tool-output-<id>\"`.

Nate L: One more: indicate when output was served from cache. Small cache icon + tooltip "Cached • since 2026-02-08". Impacts how teams debug results.

Asha R: Action items: I will iterate the figma to show compact summaries + expanded panel state, Priya will add aria callouts and copy tweaks, Tom will mock the "Replay from here" interactions, Nate will add perf/cache badge comps. Sync tomorrow 10:00 AM.

Tom K: :ok_hand:

Priya S: Adding notes to the design doc now.

DevBot: Reminder: design review meeting scheduled for 2026-03-24 10:00:00 (UTC).
